Which statement about ions and ionic bonding is correct?
A
Caesium atoms gain electrons to form negatively charged caesium ions.
B
Ionic bonding involves sharing of pairs of electrons.
C
Potassium ions and chloride ions have the same number of outer-shell electrons.
D
Sodium ions have an equal number of protons and electrons.
